about: I build Android apps in Kotlin with both Jetpack Compose and classic XML views. At Agile Interface I'm now sharing code across Android, iOS and web with Compose Multiplatform.

projects.name: Qibla Finder
projects.summary: High-accuracy utility app featuring real-time magnetometer sensor fusion for live compass direction, astronomical prayer calculation algorithms, Hijri lunar calendar, and background prayer alerts via WorkManager.

projects.name: Street View Navigation
projects.summary: Interactive navigation and street-level exploration platform integrating 360° panoramic tile rendering, Mapbox 3D vector map layers, real-time traffic status feeds, and voice-assisted turn-by-turn routing.

projects.name: AdsNextGen
projects.summary: Open-source Android library simplifying monetization workflows. Wraps Google Mobile Ads Next-Gen SDK with lifecycle-aware Kotlin Coroutines and StateFlow for Banner, Interstitial, Rewarded, and Native ad mediation.

experience.summary: Building our own Compose Multiplatform products for Android, iOS and web.

Architected and shipped flagship utility apps, including Street View Navigation and Qibla Finder, scaling them to 150K+ combined downloads with 4.5★+ ratings while establishing core Clean Architecture and ad mediation standards.
Engineered real-time voice and text translation pipelines and built adaptive CarPlay head-unit integrations with hands-free voice-command handling and low-latency audio processing.

services.title: Native Android Engineering
services.text: Production-grade Android apps built with modern Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and Clean Architecture. Engineered for smooth 60/120 FPS performance, offline-first reliability, and strict adherence to Google Play policies.

services.title: Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP)
services.text: Cross-platform development sharing core business logic or complete UIs across Android and iOS using Compose Multiplatform (CMP). Cuts time-to-market in half while retaining 100% native speed and Swift/SwiftUI interoperability.

services.title: Ad Monetization & Mediation
services.text: Revenue-optimized ad stacks integrating AdMob and multi-network mediation (Mintegral, IronSource, Pangle). Non-intrusive banner, interstitial, and rewarded ad architectures that maximize eCPMs without killing user retention.

services.title: Maps, Sensors & Navigation
services.text: Location-aware applications featuring custom Mapbox 3D vector tiles, Street View rendering, turn-by-turn voice routing, and hardware sensor fusion (magnetometer, accelerometer, and GPS).

services.title: SDK & Modular Library Development
services.text: Self-contained Android SDKs and reusable KMP shared modules. Designed with minimal dependencies, lifecycle-aware Kotlin Coroutines, and automated CI/CD distribution via Maven and GitHub Packages.

services.title: Architecture & Code Audits
services.text: Refactoring legacy Java/XML codebases into modern Jetpack Compose and Coroutines/Flow. Deep profiling to resolve ANRs, reduce APK size, fix memory leaks, and modernize dependency injection.
